title: Real Source Snapshot Runner
purpose: Retrieve admitted benchmark sources into a trusted GitHub Actions artifact, bind exact bytes to SourceAdmission records, and emit a path-free snapshot manifest without committing the corpus to Git.
invariants: Only sources that pass pre-ingestion admission prerequisites are downloaded.
Downloaded bytes are stored only in the workflow artifact, not committed to Git.
Every successfully retrieved source is immediately bound to a SourceAdmission SHA-256 record.
The snapshot manifest contains only logical IDs, hashes, byte counts, decisions and artifact-relative locators; no runner host paths.
Caller-version sources such as Légifrance bind the explicit snapshot date.
Duplicate content across distinct primary benchmark sources fails the snapshot.

M3.2, M3.2.5 reliability and SourceAdmission gate code remain unchanged; the benchmark catalog may replace transport-incompatible candidates only with provenance/rights-equivalent or stronger official sources.
A retrieval failure is a HOLD, never silently skipped.
The snapshot runner performs retrieval only; it does not parse PDFs, extract OCR, call models or publish kits.
requiredEvidence: Exact seven-path delta from the SourceAdmission main baseline.
Repository governance PASS and PR scope PASS.
M3.2, M3.2.5 reliability and SourceAdmission regression oracles remain PASS.
The first real snapshot HOLD is preserved as evidence and its four transport failures are corrected by official alternatives rather than bypassed.
Synthetic snapshot oracle proves eight primary domains can bind distinct source bytes.
Permission-required OpenStax and NICE controls remain pre-ingestion and un-downloaded.
A source retrieval failure produces HOLD_REAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_V1.
Duplicate primary source content produces HOLD_REAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_V1.
The legal benchmark binds an exact official EUR-Lex CELEX/OJ version; caller-bound version behavior remains covered by SourceAdmission.
Snapshot manifest contains no physical host path.
Trusted branch run attempts the real V1 catalog and uploads the exact source/admission bundle as an Actions artifact.
adversarialTests: Network failure for one primary source.
Same source bytes returned for two different primary domains.
Dynamic version source without valid snapshot date.
HTML error page returned for a PDF or ZIP URL.
Catalog replacement weakens a rights constraint merely to make transport pass.
independentReview: The real branch snapshot is evidence, not a promotion decision.
An Actions artifact is an operational short-term store for this benchmark; retention/storage promotion can be decided after the first corpus proves useful.
M3.2.5 promotion still requires actual FactoryRuns plus independent semantic reviews and the existing benchmark gate.
rollback: Remove the additive snapshot runner/tests/workflow/router entry. The source catalog, source admission layer, M3.2 and M3.2.5 reliability remain unchanged.
